failed_attempts.explanation: Four cases timed out before the intended recovery boundary. Retained records were not_dispatched with pending collection and failed cleanup. The worker reported a VM still reachable after scope kill, without a PID. Shared examples now use 60-second operation / 55-second receive budgets to match the existing preparation profile. The full 25-case rerun passed; command deadlines, retention, leases and no-replay semantics were not changed.

limitations: Finite deployment evidence, not a security audit or universal hostile-code guarantee.
No macOS or Linux ARM64 1.14.6 runtime qualification.
Synchronous block I/O only; no asynchronous engine qualification.
One active execution, offline approved artifacts, no concurrent tenants or production credentials.
Host tasks are not guest PIDs; charged memory is not per-process RSS; CPU bandwidth is not accumulated CPU time.
Failed startup can still require external worker teardown; unknown outcomes never authorize command replay.
Historical 1.14.1 and shared-filesystem cleanup comparison evidence remain separate.
No new GitHub Actions run, release tag, Hex publication or GitHub Release.
